name: mcp-hub-sample-project
description: Sample microservices project with MCP Hub access control

scripts.start: concurrently --names "auth,booking,gateway,client" --prefix-colors "green,yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run start -w auth-service" "npm run start -w booking-service" "npm run start -w api-gateway" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "auth,booking,gateway,client" --prefix-colors "green,yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev -w auth-service" "npm run dev -w booking-service" "npm run dev -w api-gateway" "npm run dev -w client"
